div.div:
Rules that make this trustworthy
• A01 can be CRITICAL only because the AI reader and the witness AGREED on every value in the equation, with no unread row in between.
• The model's visual opinion (V01, P1) could only raise suspicion; code findings set the verdict.
• The memo never sees the document; every number in it is checked against computed facts.
• The analyst, not the model, makes the decision; the API enforces the guards.
